Photo by Joe DelNero, NLR 86193 27 https://dx.doi.org/10.1021/acsaem.5c00760 60 | Advanced Computing Annual Report 2025 Advanced Computing Annual Report 2025 | 61 Uncovering High-Performance Materials for Calcium Batteries Calcium batteries, which consist of widely abundant resources, could be an alternative to today’s lithium-based energy storage systems. However, the development of these batteries is still in its infancy. A major challenge to progressing this technology is the lack of demonstrated calcium solid- state electrolytes, key substances that influence battery conductivity and stability. Student researchers from Rutgers University are addressing this gap using materials data mining and screening, high-throughput calculations, and ML-accelerated simulations. To discover new high-performance calcium-based solid-state electrolytes, with compute power from Kestrel, the team has screened thousands of potential compositions, mapping mechanisms that could enable the high conductivities needed for calcium solid-state batteries. The researchers are also exploring how vacancy, non-stoichiometry, disorder, and weakly coordinating polyatomic anions can be incorporated into the calcium ionic conductors to open up faster-ion transport pathways. Scientific insights from this work, featured in Energy & Fuels,28 are building the fundamental understanding and computational methods needed to develop safe, high-performance batteries.
